title: Log Rollup
description: Long-term numbers summarised hourly from Loki logs. Source: InfluxDB bucket log_rollup (CronJob apps/log-rollup in day2-services). Raw logs: Cluster Logs dashboard.

panels.title: Firewall events
panels.description: Firewall lines in the selected range (UDM default-policy logging).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "log_rollup")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "log_events" and r._field == "count" and r.class == "firewall")
  |> group()
  |> sum()

panels.title: Error-like lines
panels.description: Container log lines that look like errors in the range.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "log_rollup")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "log_events" and r._field == "count" and r.class == "error_like")
  |> group()
  |> sum()

panels.title: SSH/auth failures
panels.description: Failed SSH and login attempts on the three nodes, from the host journals: 'Failed password', 'Invalid user', 'authentication failure', 'Connection closed by authenticating user'. 0 means none logged in the range.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "log_rollup")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "log_events" and r._field == "count" and r.class == "auth_fail")
  |> group()
  |> sum()

panels.title: OOM kills
panels.description: Kernel or earlyoom kills in the range.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "log_rollup")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "log_events" and r._field == "count" and r.class == "oom")
  |> group()
  |> sum()

panels.title: Rollup last ran
panels.description: Time since the last hourly rollup heartbeat. Over 2h means it is stalled.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "log_rollup")
  |> range(start: -6h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "log_rollup_run" and r._field == "points")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: float(v: int(v: now()) - int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0}))

panels.title: Firewall events by action
panels.description: drop = blocked, default = default-policy return, allow = explicit allow.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "log_rollup")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "log_events" and r._field == "count" and r.class == "firewall")
  |> group(columns: ["action"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: if int(v: v.windowPeriod) > 3600000000000 then v.windowPeriod else 1h, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Firewall events by source zone
panels.description: Which network the traffic came in on.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "log_rollup")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "log_events" and r._field == "count" and r.class == "firewall")
  |> group(columns: ["in_zone"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: if int(v: v.windowPeriod) > 3600000000000 then v.windowPeriod else 1h, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Firewall events by rule set
panels.description: LAN_LOCAL = traffic to the gateway itself. Inter-VLAN sets appear once those rules log.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "log_rollup")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "log_events" and r._field == "count" and r.class == "firewall")
  |> group(columns: ["ruleset"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: if int(v: v.windowPeriod) > 3600000000000 then v.windowPeriod else 1h, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Error-like lines by namespace
panels.description: Container logs that look like errors. Noisy by nature: watch for changes, not absolute numbers.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "log_rollup")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "log_events" and r._field == "count" and r.class == "error_like")
  |> group(columns: ["namespace"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: if int(v: v.windowPeriod) > 3600000000000 then v.windowPeriod else 1h, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Auth failures by node
panels.description: Same as the SSH/auth failures tile, split by node: failed SSH and login attempts per hour. No line means none logged.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "log_rollup")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "log_events" and r._field == "count" and r.class == "auth_fail")
  |> group(columns: ["node"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: if int(v: v.windowPeriod) > 3600000000000 then v.windowPeriod else 1h, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: OOM kills by node
panels.description: Out-of-memory kills from kernel and earlyoom.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "log_rollup")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "log_events" and r._field == "count" and r.class == "oom")
  |> group(columns: ["node"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: if int(v: v.windowPeriod) > 3600000000000 then v.windowPeriod else 1h, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Log volume by type (MB per hour)
panels.description: How much each log type produces. Retention tiers: host and UDM events 13 months, default 6 months, UDM chatter and argocd 30 days.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "log_rollup")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "log_volume" and r._field == "bytes")
  |> group(columns: ["signal_type"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: if int(v: v.windowPeriod) > 3600000000000 then v.windowPeriod else 1h, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value) / 1000000.0}))

panels.title: Top firewall sources
panels.description: Top sources per hour, summed over the range (each hour keeps its own top 10).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "log_rollup")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "fw_top_src" and r._field == "count")
  |> group(columns: ["src", "ruleset", "action"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 15)
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "count"})
  |> keep(columns: ["src", "ruleset", "action", "count"])

panels.title: Top destination ports
panels.description: Top destination ports per hour, summed over the range.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "log_rollup")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "fw_top_dport" and r._field == "count")
  |> group(columns: ["dport", "ruleset", "action"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 15)
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "count"})
  |> keep(columns: ["dport", "ruleset", "action", "count"])

panels.title: Discovery chatter by device (not in the counts above)
panels.description: Broadcast and multicast announcements (Tuya smart plugs on port 6667, vacuum, UniFi access points, gateway discovery). Excluded from the firewall charts so real events stand out; shown here so a change in who is chatting is still visible.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "log_rollup")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "fw_discovery" and r._field == "count")
  |> group(columns: ["in_zone", "src", "dport"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 20)
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "count"})
  |> keep(columns: ["in_zone", "src", "dport", "count"])
